title: Shoshana Zuboff on surveillance capitalism | VPRO Documentary
summary: A VPRO documentary in which Harvard professor Shoshana Zuboff explains her book on surveillance capitalism. It covers how Google and Facebook turn personal data into raw material for prediction and behavioral influence.
why: Linked as a reference in privacy and big tech threads for framing the business model of data extraction.

quote.text: spells out the history and The Truth in a very 21st Century way
